text:
maria (support): Hi team — customer kevin reports their free-trial balance dropped ~12k credits overnight, says embeddings jobs ran repeatedly. customer id: C-4021. Can someone look?
jordan (oncall): tagging — @jen can you grab logs for C-4021? suspect retry fanout but need request ids + API key used.
maria (support): I pulled the audit: key sk_live_***-4021 made a series of POST /v1/embeddings calls from 02:03–02:09 UTC, ~240 requests. They look like identical payloads, content batch size=512.
jen (eng-runtime): thanks. can you paste a sample request id / response? also whether these were from our hosted endpoint or the dedicated pool.
maria (support): sample: request_id=01H3X7Z9, resp 200 then 502 and then 200. Logs show exponential backoff retries client-side but each retry appears to have created new server-side jobs (no idempotency token). snippet:
```
02:03:12 POST /v1/embeddings 200 req=01H3X7Z9 body=[...512 vectors...]
02:03:18 POST /v1/embeddings 502 req=01H3X7Z9-retry1
02:03:24 POST /v1/embeddings 200 req=01H3X7Z9-retry2
```
jordan (oncall): hmm. client retries + missing idempotency => repeated billing. also check our background cron for ingest requeues — crons-bot shows a reschedule event around 02:02.
crons-bot: cron/vec-sync pod kubecrd-vec-3 failed to acquire lock, rescheduled job id job-9f2c at 02:01:58 UTC. (automated)
jen (eng-runtime): that matches. lock TTL was short after recent helm change — two pod replicas ended up running same job; each sent the same batch to embeddings, and clients retried due to 502s, causing duplicate processing. also our API didn't enforce idempotency for the batch endpoint.
alex (billing): quantify impact: how many billed units per duplicate request? estimate ~50 credits/request * 240 = 12k. matches customer report.
maria (support): customer says they used the SDK with default retry settings (lib-v2). they expected idempotency to protect them. they want a refund + fix.
jen (eng-runtime): immediate mitigation: 1) suspend sk_live_***-4021 to stop further calls (actioned). 2) add temporary rate-limit override to reject new batch uploads > 10/s for that key (scheduled now). 3) create incident PR for lock TTL rollback and idempotency shim.
jordan (oncall): I opened INC-2891 and linked logs + metrics. added watcher for credits-per-key spike; alert threshold set to +5x baseline.
alex (billing): we can issue a credit for 12,000 units now to their account and set spend-protection to prevent surprise. will confirm after we reconcile with logs.
kevin (customer): thanks, appreciate the quick pause. can you also share steps you recommend so our SDK usage is safer until idempotency landed?
maria (support): recommended short-term client steps we gave:
- set max_retries=2
- enable exponential_backoff with jitter
- send an `Idempotency-Key` header per logical batch (we'll start enforcing server-side soon)
- add server-side dedupe on your side if possible (store batch hash)
kevin (customer): implemented idempotency-key generator and reduced retries — thanks.
jen (eng-runtime): follow-ups: 1) revert helm lock TTL change and add integration test for multi-replica cron. 2) add server-side idempotency check for /v1/embeddings to ignore duplicate batch payloads within 10m (PR queued). 3) add billing reconciliation job to flag keys with rapid charge spikes for manual review.
jordan (oncall): who owns the PR? jen?
jen (eng-runtime): yes, will own. PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821. ETA for hotfix: 4 hours to deploy to prod cluster, then monitor for 24h.
alex (billing): issuing 12,000 credit to C-4021 now, applying spend-protection and emailing customer. tagging finance for record.
maria (support): customer notified with temporary credit + postmortem ETA. they replied :thumbsup:
kevin (customer): confirmation — credit received, throttling in place, and your suggested SDK changes applied. please keep me in loop on root cause fix.
jen (eng-runtime): will post updates in INC-2891. after hotfix we'll run a dry-run to ensure dedupe works. FYI adding metrics to show idempotency hit rate.
jordan (oncall): closing loop: immediate mitigation done, billing credit issued, engineering hotfix in progress. will convert to full postmortem if duplicates found in other keys. thanks :eyes:
maria (support): filing follow-up tasks: PM notify, customer comms template, add KB article for "unexpected trial burn: duplicate embeddings due to cron lock". link to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2891
alex (billing): done. marking thread as resolved from support side, leaving engineering to close.
jen (eng-runtime): will update status after deploy. :rocket:
